name: Ember Trailers
description: Streams official YouTube trailers through your server with yt-dlp (kept up to date automatically) and builds Ember's Coming Soon calendar from TMDB using the key Jellyfin already has, plus Trakt if you add a key. Nothing is stored.
overview: Official trailers and a release calendar for the Ember app, served by your Jellyfin server.

versions.changelog: Trailers start faster and more reliably: prefers YouTube's ready-combined HD streams instead of joining video and audio live. Adds a playback test for admins in Ember. (Jellyfin 12)
Trailers start faster and more reliably: prefers YouTube's ready-combined HD streams instead of joining video and audio live. Adds a playback test for admins in Ember. (Jellyfin 10.11)

Fixes trailers falling back to YouTube: downloads Deno (the JavaScript runtime yt-dlp now needs for YouTube), trusts trailers TMDB marks as official, and tells Ember why a trailer could not play. (Jellyfin 12)
